Five-condition full-benchmark evaluation
五条件全量评测与分层分析

Scope and protocol / 范围与评测协议

This report covers S0, SC, S1, S2 and S3 across V*, ZoomBench, HRBench-4K, HRBench-8K, MME-RealWorld and MME-RealWorld-CN. The same benchmark samples are paired across conditions. / 本报告覆盖S0、SC、S1、S2、S3五种条件及V*、ZoomBench、HRBench-4K、HRBench-8K、MME-RealWorld和MME-RealWorld-CN六个评测集；同一评测集样本在各条件间配对比较。

Three score views are kept distinct: (1) the official Vision-OPD cal_acc.py exact-label result, (2) a diagnostic decision parsed from the exact final nonempty line of the same raw judge output, and (3) local Qwen structured text-only answer extraction. The official result reproduces str(judge).strip().lower() == "yes" and is cross-checked against all saved official accuracy logs. Terminal-line results are not substituted for official scores. / 分别保留三种评分视角：(1) Vision-OPD官方cal_acc.py精确标签结果，(2)从同一裁判原始输出最终非空行解析的诊断判定，(3)本地Qwen结构化纯文本答案抽取。官方结果严格复现str(judge).strip().lower() == "yes"，并与30份官方准确率日志逐项核对；终行结果不替代官方分数。

The terminal-line diagnostic accepts only exact “Yes” or “No”; other text is counted as not-correct and reported separately. Full raw judge text remains in the machine-readable merged table. / 终行诊断仅接受精确的“Yes”或“No”；其他终行按未答对处理并单独报告。机器可读合并表保留完整裁判原始文本。

Verified joined records / 已验证合并记录：160,810 · Conditions / 条件：S0, SC, S1, S2, S3 · Tracks / 评测集：V*, ZoomBench, HRBench-4K, HRBench-8K, MME-RealWorld, MME-RealWorld-CN

Key findings and interpretation / 核心发现与解读

Official-score format caveat / 官方分数的格式解释边界： Vision-OPD's original rule counts a record correct only when the entire raw judge field is exactly “Yes” after trimming. The per-condition format audit therefore matters: non-binary raw text—including reasoning followed by an answer—cannot count as correct under that rule. The official metric is reproduced faithfully, but a change in it must not automatically be interpreted as a change in semantic answer accuracy. / Vision-OPD原规则只有在完整原始judge字段去除首尾空白后严格等于“Yes”时才计为正确，因此必须同时查看各条件的原始格式审计：非二元原文（包括“推理+答案”）按原规则不会被计为正确。这里忠实复现官方指标，但不能把它的变化自动解释为语义答题准确率变化。

Paired S0→S3 contrast / S0→S3配对对比： The official score changes by +10.68 percentage points (95% image-cluster CI +10.15 to +11.23); the terminal-line diagnostic changes by -2.56 pp (95% CI -2.93 to -2.19); independent text-only extraction changes by -0.97 pp (95% CI -1.32 to -0.61). The three estimates point in different directions; report the score source explicitly and avoid presenting the official-score increase alone as evidence of improved answer correctness. / 官方分数变化+10.68个百分点（图像聚类95%置信区间+10.15至+11.23）；终行诊断变化-2.56个百分点（95%区间-2.93至-2.19）；独立纯文本答案抽取变化-0.97个百分点（95%区间-1.32至-0.61）。三种估计方向不一致；报告结果时须明确评分来源，不能只凭官方分数上升就断言答题正确率提高。

Output length / 输出长度： Mean completion tokens change from 336.9 (S0) to 260.3 (S3), a -22.7% change. This is a generation-length result, separate from whether the answer is correct. / 平均输出Token数从S0的336.9变为S3的260.3，变化幅度-22.7%。这是生成长度结果，与答案是否正确是不同维度。

Non-binary labels / 非二元标签： Across the five conditions, 74,720 raw native-judge records do not match an exact Yes/No label; 54 terminal outputs are neither exact Yes nor exact No. These records remain visible in the audit tables. / 五种条件合计有74,720条原生裁判原文不符合精确Yes/No标签格式；其中54条终行也不是精确Yes或No。这些记录均保留在审计表中。

Condition overview / 条件总览

Micro accuracy weights every sample equally across the full pooled set; macro-track accuracy gives each benchmark equal weight. Both are reported because benchmark sizes differ substantially. / Micro准确率对合并后的每个样本等权；Macro-track准确率对每个评测集等权。由于评测集规模差异较大，两者并列报告。

Visual analyses / 可视化分析

Paired comparisons / 配对比较

Primary contrast: each prompted condition versus S0, using the same sample keys. “B correct, A wrong” and “A correct, B wrong” are discordant pairs for the exact McNemar test. Confidence intervals resample image clusters. / 主要对比为每种提示条件与S0在相同样本键上的配对差异。“B答对、A答错”与“A答对、B答错”构成精确McNemar检验的非一致配对；置信区间按图像簇重抽样。
